title: The Walking Dead: Private Film Locations Tour of Senoia
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children must be accompanied by a paying adult
Tour is for Ages 13+ Only, children ages 13-17 must be accompanied by an Adult
policies: We do not allow the special requirements note without prior approval
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Please NOTE: This is a film location tour from Atlanta TO Senoia. The tour does not include entry to any studios.

Experience a personalized private 3-hour walking and driving tour of film locations of the home base for The Walking Dead. Located approximately an hour south, escape Atlanta to visit the town and surrounding areas that host the production of the popular show. Transportation from the city is provided so fans can see the settlements of both Woodbury and Alexandria. Don't miss this great opportunity to step into the world of The Walking Dead!
